projects.title: Public Law and Litigation Research File
projects.scenario: A fictional public board cancels a licence and commences proceedings against the provider. Construct a record that separates constitutional review, civil procedure and criminal safeguards.
deliverables: A 1,200-word research memorandum with a narrowly framed question, verified primary authorities and one adverse argument per issue
A source-status log, procedural chronology and forum map distinguishing civil and criminal routes
Two alternative relief sections explaining scope, authority and factual assumptions

projects.title: Private Rights and Community Land Clinic
projects.scenario: A fictional cooperative purchases equipment and proposes a lease over disputed community land. A damaged shipment and overlapping survey create different claims.
deliverables: A contract-risk and tort-liability matrix distinguishing parties, conduct and remedies
A land-category, boundary and representation report with a version comparison and participation questions
A 1,400-word balanced opinion and a plain-language 400-word explainer preserving unresolved rights

projects.title: Public Procurement and Cross-Border Commerce Dossier
projects.scenario: A fictional public tender involves a foreign supplier, a director’s interest and a disputed payment instrument. A later judgment is obtained abroad.
deliverables: A procurement criteria audit using current instruments and relevant transition checks
A corporate conflict report and payment-chain diagram identifying each asserted claim
A 1,500-word cross-border strategy separating procurement review, contractual remedies and judgment recognition

projects.title: Rights, Family and Evidence Research Portfolio
projects.scenario: A fictional family disputes estate administration while a community organisation considers a regional rights complaint. An expert report and privileged email are contested.
deliverables: An estate inventory, administration-authority note and confidential-information handling plan
An expert-method review and separate privilege schedule with locally sourced objections
A 1,600-word research memorandum with a domestic-remedies chronology and citation audit

projects.title: Employment, Environmental and Tax Compliance Opinion
projects.scenario: A fictional training enterprise expands its facility, changes staff arrangements and receives a disputed tax assessment. Residents raise a water-access concern.
deliverables: An employment-status and pay reconciliation with auditable assumptions
An environmental authorisation and participation matrix tied to the actual revised design
A 1,600-word integrated opinion with a tax objection schedule, lawful options and source-based procedural questions

projects.title: Fiduciary Finance and Intellectual Property Case Study
projects.scenario: A fictional education fund finances a startup and licenses course media. Its administrator has an undisclosed business interest and a lender claims the startup’s equipment.
deliverables: A trust-classification and fund-reconciliation report distinguishing authority, loss and gain
A current CBL instrument-status table and collateral-priority timeline identifying third-party property
A 1,700-word fiduciary-and-IP opinion with a rights-and-licences register and a reasoned counterargument

projects.title: Independent Research Capstone
projects.scenario: Choose a narrow Liberian legal question arising from the course. Use published sources and fictional or properly public facts; do not collect private client data or claim to conduct supervised legal practice.
deliverables: A 700-word proposal with question, method, scope, ethics and source plan
A 3,500–4,500-word critical research paper using at least twelve checked sources, including relevant primary authorities, and an annotated bibliography
A claim-to-source matrix, adverse-authority discussion, limitations statement and 500-word revision reflection

projects.title: Professional Moot and Reasoned Opinion
projects.scenario: Use one fictional appellate record about a disputed supply agreement, board authority, community access and evidence. Establish the applicable local review framework; argue both sides before deciding.
deliverables: Two opposing 1,500-word memorials with authorities, record pinpoints and precise requested relief
Two eight-minute oral submissions and responses to six bench questions per side; self-record or rehearse privately
A 1,500-word reasoned opinion, twenty-six-subject portfolio index and rubric-based self-assessment
